name: mirage
text: Found the actual blocker for tennis. The engine's league list had lost ATP and WTA again. The phone's copy of the settings kept overwriting my change, because the app's own league list doesn't include tennis. So SharpAPI's feed never even asked for a tennis match. I fixed it in the code: the live lane now always reads ATP and WTA whenever live tennis is switched on, whatever the league list says. It's landed on main and the engine is restarting on it (this restart takes a few minutes). I'll tell you what the lane shows once it's up. Still to build: the Tennis section in the Live tab, and running several live feeds together.
